audit.poe: A chaos arrow that bursts and leaves caustic ground that damages enemies standing in it over time; area damage over time that scales with DoT and projectile modifiers.
audit.bob: A bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.5 with 60% chaos conversion and a 100% poison chance. The lasting ground is replaced by poison on everyone hit by the burst, which follows the enemy and scales with poison mods instead of ground DoT.
audit.repair: Leave a ground zone at the burst whose damage is a per-second chaos effect on enemies in it (the ground behaviour exists) rather than relying on poison.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A retaliation skill: it can only be used for 2 s after you block a hit, then slams a giant fist for enormous area damage on a 4 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use mace/axe/staff slam at 150-190% with a stun duration bonus (not part of the original); the block-gated retaliation and its huge payoff are gone, so it is a generic slam spammed at will.
audit.repair: Gate the skill on a 2 s window opened by a successful block (the sim has block events and triggers) with a cooldown, and give it the big retaliation multiplier.

audit.poe: Instant lightning that chains between nearby enemies (and in this version also forks to a second enemy on each chain, stronger with more chains remaining), with shock.
audit.bob: Chain behaviour: hits the target, then jumps to the nearest unhit enemy in chainRange (4) with line of sight, 2 chains +1 per 5 levels, 10% shock. Every chain deals the same damage, and there is no secondary fork.
audit.repair: Optional: a damage-per-remaining-chain scaling and a fork flag on the chain behaviour; numeric rather than a loop change.

audit.poe: Reserve mana for flat energy shield plus 30% increased ES recharge rate, so ES builds recover faster.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for flat ES only. The engine does have an esRechargeRate stat (defence.ts) that this aura never sets, so the recharge half is missing.
audit.repair: Add an esRechargeRate inc mod (about 30) to the aura's mods.

audit.poe: A wide barrage of arrows landing in sequence around the target area, giving a bow a cheap area-clear attack.
audit.bob: A delayed (0.5 s) ground burst of radius 3 at the target for one pulse at 180-220%; the sequence of many arrow hits is folded into one pulse.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: The bow shot flies up and lands at the target, then arrows burst out in a ring from there. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: Just +4 projectiles in a forward fan with less damage; no landing point, no ring.
audit.repair: Fire a payload that lands at the aim point and spawns a ring of projectiles from it.

audit.poe: Hits penetrate fire resistance.
audit.bob: Penetration fire.

audit.poe: Raises a spectre of a defeated monster, so the choice of which monster to copy and its skills define the build.
audit.bob: One or two generic chaos bolt shades (the 'spectre' minion), not tied to any monster or corpse.
audit.repair: Let it pick a monster type from the roster (e.g. the most recent or chosen kill) and copy its attack into the minion.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A dual-wield retaliation: usable for 2 s after a block, it rains blades in front eight times, each with both weapons' damage combined, on a 3 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use self-centred burst that echoes once (repeats:1), usable with one weapon of sword, axe or mace; no block gate, no dual-wield requirement (the engine supports needsDualWield) and no eight-hit barrage.
audit.repair: Gate on a post-block window with a 3 s cooldown, require dual wielding, and land several hits with both weapons.

audit.poe: Channelled flamethrower whose cone widens and lengthens as you hold it, with damage that grows per stage, and a final wave that applies a strong ignite when you stop.
audit.bob: A fire beam (4.5 by 2.4) every 0.2 s at 45% effectiveness. The sustained stream form survives, but the widening with stages, the stage damage and the release ignite are gone and the channelling tag is inert.
audit.repair: Stage counter that grows the beam's length and width and damage while the skill keeps firing, plus a final strong ignite on stop.

audit.poe: A trap that explodes in fire and leaves burning ground that keeps damaging enemies who walk through it, with bonus fire damage against burning targets.
audit.bob: A trap that opens a fire ground zone (radius 2, 1.75 s, hit every 0.25 s) with ignite chance; the burning-ground persistence is kept, only the extra added fire damage versus burning enemies is omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Teleport to a nearby enemy, slam, and leave consecrated ground (life regeneration) in an area.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 7 and a half-fire burst r2 150..184%; ground dropped, so the teleport-slam survives but without a lasting effect.
audit.repair: Leave a 'ground' zone granting life regeneration to the player standing in it.

audit.poe: A golem that gives you extra physical damage reduction and fights with chaos attacks.
audit.bob: One chaos golem with splash melee; the owner gets +3-4% physical damage reduction (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Hold to gain stages, release to fire an arrow that leaves spore pods that bloom into thorn arrows; more stages mean more pods and damage. A commitment-for-power chaos/poison bow skill.
audit.bob: A steady three-arrow chaos fan with 60% poison chance (both real) and a cheap per-use cost; there is no stage build-up and no spore pods blooming later, so it is an averaged volley without the ramp or the lingering pods.
audit.repair: Add a stage count that rises while the skill is used on a target and scales the arrow count/damage, and leave pods along the path that fire thorn arrows.

audit.poe: Teleport-strike with a 2 s cooldown that can be bypassed by spending a Frenzy Charge, plus a movement-speed buff; charges become burst and mobility.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 8, 142..168% damage, 15% chance on hit to gain Fervour and +10% more attack speed per Fervour charge (both real via chargeOn.hit and 'per' charges.fervour). No cooldown, no charge-spend, no move buff; charges only accumulate and are never consumed (sim/charges.ts has no spend).
audit.repair: Give the attack a 2 s cooldown that a Fervour charge can bypass (spend one), and add a short move-speed buff on use.

audit.poe: Cold nova around the caster that leaves a whirling vortex dealing cold damage over time and chilling; 1.8 s cooldown; can detonate Frostbolt projectiles.
audit.bob: Primary spell: a 'ground' zone (r2.6, 3 s, pulses every 0.5 s) placed on the target within 6 tiles, with +chill effect; real zone pulses in actions.ts/zones. No cooldown, not centred on the caster, no initial nova, no Frostbolt interaction.
audit.repair: Optional: centre the zone on the caster (origin self) and add a small cooldown; the Frostbolt-detonation niche needs a frostbolt-tagged projectile registry (low value).

audit.poe: Flat life gained for each enemy hit by the supported attack; sustain for hit-heavy builds.
audit.bob: lifeOnHit base [3,22] on the skill's profile; combat.ts applyHit adds it per enemy hit (capped at life cap). Works as intended.

audit.poe: Buff: attack speed and life leech at the price of life degeneration; kills refresh the duration and may give a frenzy charge.
audit.bob: Upkeep buff (9 s, cd 9): attackSpeed inc 5..15, leech.life 1.2 on attacks. Degen drawback, kill-refresh and charge-on-kill are all dropped.
audit.repair: Add a buff-linked life drain mod, kill refresh of the buff timer, and chargeOn.kill.fervour inside the buff.

audit.poe: Hits leech life based on damage dealt.
audit.bob: leech.life 2% for attacks (spells are excluded; PoE allows any hit).

audit.poe: More physical damage, no elemental or chaos damage.
audit.bob: Same flags (noElementalDamage/noChaosDamage) consumed in buildProfile; more physical.

audit.poe: A melee strike (half converted to lightning) that also throws projectiles from the struck enemy to hit farther-away targets; a melee skill with ranged reach.
audit.bob: Behaviour is a pure projectile fan (5 bolts, 70 degrees, range 7) from the caster at -25% each; there is no melee hit, and all bolts share a per-use hit list so one target takes a single bolt. It plays as a short-range shotgun-free fan, not a strike with spawned bolts.
audit.repair: Add a hybrid behaviour: a melee hit on the target followed by projectiles launched from the target's position at other enemies.

audit.poe: Delayed teleport that deals lightning damage at both origin and destination; warps can be queued.
audit.bob: Plain blink (distance 9, cd 3, cast 0.8). No delay mechanic, no area damage at either end, no queueing.
audit.repair: Blink with a lightning area hit at both endpoints (the delay already roughly exists as cast time).

audit.poe: A trap that fires a ring of lightning projectiles with shock chance and extra critical chance against shocked enemies, so shock feeds crits.
audit.bob: A 9-projectile 360 degree ring with 20% shock chance and scaling shock effect; the crit-chance-versus-shocked-enemies stat (80-118%) that is in the reference data is not on the definition.
audit.repair: Add critChance inc 80-118 with condition targetShocked (the engine already supports it, as Spire Trap shows).

audit.poe: Consumes a corpse (and more corpses for longer duration) to give your minions attack and spell block with life recovery on block.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff on the character: 25-35% attack and spell block for 8 s; no corpse, no minion buff (minions get block only from minionBlock gear), so the minion-protection role is lost.
audit.repair: Apply the block (and life on block) to live minions and let nearby corpses extend its duration. I am unsure whether the 3.9 effect also covers the player.

audit.poe: Shortens a duration skill's effect for more damage: trade lasting effect for burst (zones, buffs, minions and traps vanish sooner).
audit.bob: skillDuration more (negative) and damage more. skillDuration is read for deployable lifetime, timed minions and the calc sheet's ground pulse count, but the sim's ground zones use b.duration / b.interval without the multiplier, and curses/buffs/ailments use other stats, so the downside barely exists in play while the damage bonus does.
audit.repair: Apply profile.skillDuration to zone pulses in the sim and to buff/hex duration, so the shorter-lasting cost is real.

audit.poe: Channel to release lightning orbs that repeatedly jump toward a target spot; when you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode for higher damage in a larger area, so you choose when to cash out.
audit.bob: A rapid burst (0.25 s cast time) on the target with half the physical converted to lightning; averaged into repeated hits with no release explosion.
audit.repair: Accumulate orbs while the skill is used on a target and detonate them as a larger burst when the target dies or the skill stops.

audit.poe: Cast curse that lowers all elemental resistances of enemies in an area for the duration.
audit.bob: A hex-kind gem that only works when Hexing Strikes sits in the same item as the primary skill; it is not castable (other curses like Tinder Curse are utility casts). The resistance reduction is real (hexTotals res, applied to enemies hit).
audit.repair: Convert it to an active spell with utility.kind curse like the other curses, keeping Hexing Strikes as an alternative route.

audit.poe: More melee physical damage; the same more multiplier also boosts bleed and poison from melee hits.
audit.bob: More melee physical damage (melee tag, physical type). Melee-tagged mods never reach ailment damage (DESIGN 6.6), so the bleed/poison half of the PoE gem is absent.
audit.repair: Optional: also give the multiplier to bleed and poison damage.

audit.poe: Charge with the off-hand shield: damage and stun chance grow the further you travel, repeated hits along the path, damage derived from shield stats.
audit.bob: Attack needing a shield with travel 8, melee range 1.5, flat 'more damage' 50 and enemy stun threshold. The port note's 'hits harder the farther it ran' is not implemented (travel is not tied to damage); no shield-derived damage.
audit.repair: Scale the charge's damage and stun with the actual travel distance and add damage from the shield's armour/evasion.

audit.poe: Melee hits give Fortify; more melee damage.
audit.bob: buffOn.meleeHit.fortify at 100% (the sim rolls it on melee hits; the buff gives 20% less damage taken for 4 s) plus more melee damage.

audit.poe: Minions are wreathed in fire: a burning aura around each deals fire damage based on its life to nearby enemies, and the minions take fire damage themselves; an area-damage minion build.
audit.bob: Only 18% more minion damage. Minions attack with rawHit and have no aura or ground burn; tickAuraBurn is player-only; no self-damage. The port note says as much.
audit.repair: Give timed pulses of fire damage to enemies near each minion (scaled by minion life) and a small self-damage drain on the minion.

audit.poe: Summons a group of skeleton warriors that melee enemies and expire after about 20 s.
audit.bob: Summons 3-8 skeletons for 20 s that run at and strike enemies, resummoned by the utility policy when depleted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Summons short-lived fast flaming skulls that rush enemies and attack rapidly.
audit.bob: Summons 3-8 fast fire spirits for 5 s that rush at enemies with a high attack rate.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A support-minion golem: it gives your non-golem minions added physical damage and hits harder for each minion near it, so it is a minion-build amplifier.
audit.bob: Adds flat physical damage to the character's own hits through ownerMods; minion damage comes only from the minionDamage multiplier (src/sim/minions.ts), so the added damage never reaches minions and the per-minion bonus is absent.
audit.repair: Add a minion added-damage stat that tickMinions reads, and a per-nearby-minion more-damage on the golem.

audit.poe: Mines that detonate in a chain: each mine sets off the next a moment later, and every detonation in the cascade adds more damage; the identity is the sequential detonation bonus.
audit.bob: Just adds the mine type and a flat damage penalty. Mines auto-detonate on their own when an enemy is within 3.5 tiles (arm 0.6 s); there is no cascade, no neighbour triggering, no per-detonation bonus. Description ('set one another off') is not implemented.
audit.repair: When one mine goes off, detonate the other mines of the set in order a fraction of a second apart, each adding a per-detonation more-damage step.

audit.poe: More elemental damage, but the skill cannot inflict elemental ailments.
audit.bob: More elemental damage plus the cannotInflictEle flag; calc/combat.ts blocks ignite, shock, chill and freeze. Bleed and poison unaffected.

audit.poe: A nova that consumes all your charges and deals fire, cold and lightning damage per endurance, frenzy and power charge removed; the trade is spending your charge buffs for a burst.
audit.bob: A nova with fire per Grit, cold per Fervour and lightning per Insight, but the charges are never consumed (no charge-spend path exists in src/sim/charges.ts), so it is a free charge-scaled nova that keeps the buffs.
audit.repair: Add a consume-charges flag on cast that zeroes the held charges after the damage is computed.

audit.poe: Hit an enemy to gain a 4 s buff, stackable to three, during which beams automatically zap several nearby enemies every ~0.4 s (stronger while you move); you pick it for the persistent AoE aura after a strike.
audit.bob: A plain melee strike with 60% lightning conversion and a flat +30% more damage; no buff, no zaps, no area (single-target melee behaviour).
audit.repair: On hit, grant a timed stacking self buff that makes the character fire a lightning pulse at nearby enemies on an interval (rate per stack), and remove the flat more-damage.

audit.poe: Channelling support that shields you from damage while you channel and grants more damage for a few seconds after channelling stops.
audit.bob: Only a flat more damage for channelling skills. The barrier (less damage taken while using the skill) and the post-channel timing window are gone; the port note admits the barrier is dropped.
audit.repair: Give the supported skill a 'while using it' defence condition (less damage taken during its action) and a short damage buff after a channelled burst ends.

audit.poe: A short-lived, fast, high-damage cold projectile that pierces and fades, losing damage and freeze chance with distance; a close-range freezer.
audit.bob: Piercing cold projectile with range 5 at 150% effectiveness and a 20% freeze chance. The fade is only the short range; there is no damage or freeze falloff (the falloff field exists in the behaviour but is not set).
audit.repair: Optional: set behaviour.falloff, and scale freeze chance with distance.

audit.poe: A fire strike that stacks a charged debuff on the target (6 stacks or expiry or death detonates it for AoE damage), and every debuffed enemy explodes on death; you pick it to turn single-target hits into delayed area bursts.
audit.bob: A plain melee strike, 50% fire conversion plus a flat 20% more damage; nothing is stacked or detonated (the 'area' tag has no area behind it, behaviour is single-target melee).
audit.repair: Add a per-target hit-stack debuff that detonates as an area burst at N stacks, on expiry and on death (the sim already has kill triggers and per-target ailment lists to hang it on), and drop the flat +20% more.

audit.poe: Totem that beams burning damage at you and every other totem, damaging enemies in between and at the ends; allows one more totem.
audit.bob: A pair of totems (deployCount +1) each pulsing a fire burst r3.4 around itself as hits, with no DoT, no link beams between totems or to the player.
audit.repair: Add a line hit between totems and the player and make it burning damage over time.

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: physical gained as fire, more spell fire damage, and when you kill any enemy, overkill damage burns the enemies near it. Rewards big hits and dense packs, needs no ignite.
audit.bob: Gain-as-fire and spell fire more are real. The kill effect only spreads an existing ignite from a dead burning enemy (sim/triggers.ts spread); it needs an ignited victim, so non-ignite builds get nothing, and there is no overkill scaling.
audit.repair: On any kill, ignite nearby enemies for a share of the dead enemy's overkill damage (needs the overkill amount passed to the kill event).

audit.poe: Blink that damages enemies on the way and leaves burning ground; shares cooldown with other blinks.
audit.bob: Identical to Quick Step: blink distance 8, cd 3. applyUtility blink code has no damage and no ground effect; fire tags and cast time 0.7 are cosmetic.
audit.repair: Let blink skills deal a spell hit at start/end point and drop a burning ground zone using the existing 'ground' zones.

audit.poe: Adds fire damage only against burning (ignited) enemies; a payoff for ignite builds, usable on any skill that hits.
audit.bob: Adds fire damage unconditionally to attacks only, plus 20% ignite chance (which creates its own burning enemy). The condition on the target being ignited is gone although the targetIgnited condition exists in the engine, and the gem is restricted to attacks.
audit.repair: Add condition targetIgnited to the damage.min/max mods and drop the attack restriction (data-only).

audit.poe: A holy fire wave that hits in a line, leaves Consecrated Ground (sustain for you) and then sends a larger shockwave that hits enemies standing on it; the fire and consecrated ground combo is the draw.
audit.bob: A burst (radius 2.4) of fire and physical spell damage at the target; the line wave, consecrated ground and follow-up shockwave are dropped, as the port note admits.
audit.repair: Leave a timed ground zone under the target that regenerates the owner's life while standing in it and carries a delayed second burst.

audit.poe: Flat-mana reservation aura that gives flat mana regeneration, a cheap fix for mana sustain.
audit.bob: Reserves a flat mana amount by level (reserveFlat) and adds manaRegenFlat, which defence.ts reads (scaled by increased mana regen).

audit.poe: Projectiles deal more damage close up and less far away.
audit.bob: More projectile damage against nearby enemies only; no far-range penalty, so no trade. The engine has a closeQuarters flag and distanceMult (1.5 down to 0.5), unused by the gem.
audit.repair: Grant the closeQuarters flag so the distance curve applies.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A wand shot that makes several explosions; it adds physical damage equal to a share of your maximum mana and takes spell-damage scaling at 150% on the attack (arcane might), so it is a mana-scaling caster wand attack.
audit.bob: A wand projectile with one wide burst (area increase 10-40%) at 110-140%; nothing scales with maximum mana and no spell-damage conversion (the engine has a spellIncAppliesToAttacks flag that is unused here), and there is a single explosion rather than a cluster.
audit.repair: Add base physical damage as a percent of maximum mana (and use the existing spell-increase-on-attacks flag at partial strength); optionally several offset explosions.

audit.poe: Channelled close-range lightning pulses in front of you; every fourth pulse is a larger, stronger one.
audit.bob: Repeated self-centred lightning bursts at 0.25 s cast time with the larger-pulse bonus averaged in as +12% more damage. This is the engine's accepted channel averaging and the average matches (3 normal + 1 at +50%).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Applies a chaos damage-over-time debuff to enemies in an area; when an affected enemy dies the debuff spreads to nearby enemies, so it snowballs through packs.
audit.bob: A ground cloud at the target (radius 2.5, 5 s, hits every 0.5 s) as direct chaos hits on whoever stands in it. No debuff that stays on the enemy, no spread on death (trigger effects exist only for shock/ignite on item triggers), no spell DoT scaling.
audit.repair: Make the cast apply a timed chaos DoT to enemies in the area, and on death of an affected enemy re-apply it to enemies nearby (extend the kill 'spread' trigger effect to this debuff).

audit.poe: Attack crits trigger the linked spell with a 0.15 s cooldown; the triggered spell costs no mana.
audit.bob: Trigger on crit with the attack tag, cooldown 0.15, castSocketed: spells in the same item become triggered-only and fire on the player's attack crits. Adds a damage bonus PoE lacks.

audit.poe: Projectile attacks: more physical damage and physical/chaos DoT, slower attack.
audit.bob: Same, with the dot bonus applying to all DoT.

audit.poe: Increases critical strike multiplier.
audit.bob: critMulti base added.

audit.poe: A slow, big single-target melee hit with extra stun (threshold reduction), knockback and a 20% chance to deal double damage; picked as the plain heavy-hitter.
audit.bob: Melee single-target hit at 150-190% with +25% stun duration and +25% stun damage, both read by the engine (stunDuration and stunDamage in buildProfile). No double-damage chance (the engine has a doubleDamage stat, unused here) and no knockback anywhere in the engine.
audit.repair: Optional: add a doubleDamage base 20 mod to the gem (engine already reads it); knockback has no engine support and is cosmetic for the bot.

audit.poe: Aura that makes nearby enemies take increased physical damage, starting at 15-19% and ramping to 30-39% over 4 s of exposure. Used by physical builds as a damage multiplier.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more physical damage mod on the character (starting value, no ramp). The enemy-debuff form is folded into a self buff; for the character's own damage it plays the same.
audit.repair: Optional: apply it as an enemy vuln so the ramp and minion damage count (existing hexVuln field). Not needed for the spirit.

audit.poe: Hits can blind enemies so they miss you more; a defensive status that does not use your curse slot.
audit.bob: A global hexOnHit.feebleGrip: every hit by any of the character's skills applies a 'less damage dealt' hex. It is an acceptable proxy for the defensive value but shares the single hex slot (BASE_HEX_LIMIT 1, sorted by effect in deriveHexes) with real curses and gets boss/hexWarded reductions, and applies to all the character's skills, not just the supported one.
audit.repair: Add a separate status layer on enemies for blind/maim/flee that does not count against hex limit, scoped to the supported skill; blind could reduce monster accuracy.

audit.poe: Guard: less physical and elemental damage; consumes up to 5 endurance charges to extend the buff and reduce physical taken further (charges -> safety).
audit.bob: Guard utility (life<60%, 4 s, cd 8): hitTaken more -25..-35. Grit charges are never consumed (no charge-spend primitive exists in sim/charges.ts) and bring no extra benefit.
audit.repair: Add spend_charges_for_effect: on cast, remove held Grit charges to lengthen the buff and deepen the reduction.

audit.poe: Larger chill effect, and chilled enemies take increased cold damage scaled by the chill (the main reason to use it).
audit.bob: Only the chill effect increase is present (read in skill.ts). Chills do not make the target take more cold damage.
audit.repair: When the supported skill chills, apply an increased-cold-damage-taken effect to the target tied to the chill.

audit.poe: Lowers the mana multiplier of the supported gems, so a supported skill with many supports costs less.
audit.bob: costMult 0.75 multiplies into the skill's cost along with other supports; the cost is read for the active skill. Auras are never supported by gems in Bob and support multipliers do not raise reservation (DESIGN 2.1), so the aura use of Enlighten is moot by design.

audit.poe: More damage against chilled enemies, more cold DoT, stronger chill, extra freeze chance.
audit.bob: More damage under targetChilled, cold DoT more, chill effect up; the extra freeze chance is dropped (minor).

audit.poe: Smaller area of effect but more area damage.
audit.bob: aoe -30% (radius is the square root) and more area damage; both read.

audit.poe: A brand that attaches to an enemy and periodically drops fiery meteors with a strong ignite bonus until it detaches.
audit.bob: A brand put down at the target that pulses a fire burst (radius 2) every 0.75 s at the nearest enemy in reach for 12 s, with ignite chance and more ignite damage; it does not attach to or follow an enemy but the pulse loop is intact.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Seals accumulate over time while you are not casting and are spent to repeat the spell; best on slow, long-delay spells, no benefit if you cast quickly.
audit.bob: One repeat on every use at less damage. The seal accumulation (repeats limited by idle time) is replaced by a constant, so fast spells repeat as much as slow ones.
audit.repair: Make the repeat count depend on time since the last cast (seals per 0.9 s, capped), applied in the sim.

audit.poe: A chance for one to three extra traps or mines on each throw, no damage penalty.
audit.bob: Guaranteed +1 deployCount with 15% less damage, replacing the chance-for-extra roll; the port note says as much. Expected deployments are similar at higher levels; the penalty is an invented drawback.

audit.poe: A trap whose beams chill and deal cold damage over time to up to ten enemies and give you large life and mana regeneration for each enemy affected, a sustain trap.
audit.bob: A cold ground zone that chills and hits for 3 s with a flat 1% life leech; the per-enemy life and mana regeneration (hundreds a second at high level) is reduced to leech on weak damage, so the sustain is negligible.
audit.repair: Add a timed owner life/mana regen that scales with the number of enemies inside the zone, in place of the 1% leech.

audit.poe: A slow orb that zaps every enemy around it many times a second as it drifts through a pack; cheap, multi-hit lightning.
audit.bob: A ground zone placed at the target (radius 2.2, 2 s, pulses every 0.4 s) hitting everything inside with low-effectiveness lightning, 10% shock. It does not move and does not follow the aim line, and the projectile-count supports are inert on it (skill.ts reads projectile count only for projectile behaviours).
audit.repair: Optional: let a ground zone carry a velocity so the orb drifts, and let projectile-count mods spawn extra zones.

audit.poe: Stance toggled by recasting (2 s cooldown): Blood gives melee 10-15% more area damage and 5% less AoE, Sand gives 10-15% more AoE and 5% less area damage, so you pick damage or reach and swap as the fight changes.
audit.bob: Free always-on buff of more melee-area damage with no cost, no AoE side and no toggle. Port note says the stances are averaged. The mod needs both melee and area tags on the skill.
audit.repair: Model two stances (damage-vs-AoE) with an auto-swap policy (for example Blood vs bosses and tight packs, Sand vs wide packs) and give each its trade-off.

audit.poe: A melee strike also strikes two extra nearby targets at once (not the same enemy); it extends a strike skill's reach across a pack and adds nothing against a single target.
audit.bob: repeats +2 at slightly less damage. Echoes re-fire at the same targetId a moment later, and a non-arc melee strike only hits that one target, so against a single enemy it is a triple hit (like Multistrike) and never reaches other enemies. The sheet counts 1+repeats lands. The use case is inverted.
audit.repair: Implement a hit-spreading effect: on a strike, also hit up to two other enemies near the target (excluding the target), instead of repeats.

audit.poe: Spell repeats once, with a cast-speed bonus and slightly less damage; the repeat costs no extra mana.
audit.bob: repeats +1 is read by the sim (updateAction fires the spell again 0.25 of the use time later, no extra cost); castSpeed -20% and damage -10% pay for it. Net DPS gain is similar to PoE. Triggered spells do not repeat. No totem/trap exclusion.

audit.poe: More elemental damage with attacks.
audit.bob: Same more multiplier for elemental types.

audit.poe: Minions gain elemental resistances and max resistance, deal more elemental damage, and apply exposure to enemies on hit.
audit.bob: Only minionDamage more (all damage types, not just elemental). minionBody has fixed resistances per kind and no support modifies them; no exposure on minion hits. The port note's 'shrug off elements' is not implemented.
audit.repair: Pass minion resistance mods into minionBody and apply a resistance-lowering hex on minion hits.

audit.poe: A golem that grants you increased damage and throws fire.
audit.bob: One ranged fire golem; the owner gains 15-20% increased damage (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Arrows are shot into the air and rain on a target area, each landing as a small fire explosion; physical is converted to fire with fire penetration.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target with a 0.6 s delay and one pulse at 150-180% (the stacked small explosions folded into one), 100% physical to fire and 15-25% fire penetration, both read by the engine.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Flaming bolts rain over a target area for about 2 s, each exploding on landing.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target (radius 2.6, 2 s, pulses every 0.25 s = 8 hits) with fire spells at low effectiveness and a wide damage spread.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Gain a share of physical damage as extra fire.
audit.bob: Gain physical as fire, handled by the conversion/gain pipeline (supports attacks only).

audit.poe: Aura giving a large fire resistance bonus and raising maximum fire resistance (up to +4).
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for resist.fire and maxResist.fire, both read by defence.ts.

audit.poe: Raises the level of the supported gem.
audit.bob: levelBonus is read in character.ts and applied to the skill's level.

audit.poe: More burning (ignite) damage.
audit.bob: More ignite-tagged damage, which reaches ignite damage.

audit.poe: An ancestor totem melee-strikes nearby enemies and, while you stand near it, gives you more attack speed; you pick it to fight beside a totem and turn positioning into a damage bonus.
audit.bob: Placing it puts an invulnerable totem 1.5 tiles toward the target that strikes with your weapon (src/sim/deploy.ts shoot); the owner attack-speed bonus is dropped (mods is empty), so it is just a free extra melee hitter while the character also fights.
audit.repair: Add a 'near own totem' condition (a standing deployable of this skill within ~7 tiles) and give the owner the more-attack-speed mod on it.

audit.poe: A slam that damages an area and then erupts again as a large aftershock after a short delay.
audit.bob: A slam burst (radius 2.4) at 85-120% with a flat +70% more damage; the aftershock is folded into the one hit rather than a second eruption, even though a ground zone with a delay is supported (Ember Downpour uses it). Total damage is about two thirds of the PoE sum and enemies are hit once.
audit.repair: Add a second burst on the same spot after a short delay (a ground behaviour with delay and two pulses) instead of the flat more-damage mod.

audit.poe: Cast curse that reduces enemy damage dealt, accuracy and critical strike chance and multiplier, a defensive curse against hard hitters.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit. Only the less damage dealt effect is real (damageMult in applyHit); accuracy, crit chance and crit multiplier reduction are missing.
audit.repair: Make it castable and add accuracy and crit penalties on cursed monsters.

audit.poe: Aura giving more spell damage and increased spell crit chance, plus a 10% chance on hit vs rare/unique to create Consecrated Ground (8 s) that regenerates life for standing allies and weakens curses on them.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for more spell damage and inc spell crit chance (tags subset check works). The consecrated ground (a defensive ground effect and an offensive-aura rider) is dropped; the engine has no ground-effect conditions.
audit.repair: Add a small on-hit chance vs rare/unique that grants a timed life-regen buff (self_buff_on_use style), standing in for the consecrated ground.

audit.poe: Ailments (DoTs) inflicted by critical strikes deal more damage over time (a damage-over-time multiplier on crit-applied ailments) (poedb, 3.27 numbers; memory for 3.9).
audit.bob: More damage tagged dot, gated on the critRecently condition, plus an extra crit chance bonus. The DoT tag reaches the ailment chunks and critRecently is read from the player's tCrit, so ailments applied soon after a crit hit harder. Approximates 'applied by a crit' with 'recently crit'.

audit.poe: Lay several extra mines per throw at a large laying-speed penalty and no damage penalty.
audit.bob: deployCount +4 and much slower cast/attack speed; no damage penalty, as in PoE. Mines are laid in a ring and auto-detonate near enemies.

audit.poe: A trap that sends rotating flames in several directions for a few seconds, hitting repeatedly and dealing more damage to burning enemies.
audit.bob: A ground line of fire from the trap toward the triggering enemy that hits every 0.35 s for 3.5 s with +25% damage versus ignited targets; the four-way rotation is reduced to one line and the ignite condition is read once at trigger time.
audit.repair: None required; optionally spawn several line zones at different angles.

audit.poe: Strength's melee damage bonus also applies to projectile attacks.
audit.bob: Only some inc projectile damage. The engine has a 'strongarm' flag that does exactly this (character.ts), but the gem does not grant it.
audit.repair: Give the support the strongarm flag as a global mod.

audit.poe: A fire projectile that explodes on the first thing it hits for area damage, with an ignite chance.
audit.bob: Projectile with explodeRadius 1.2: on first contact it explodes and hits every enemy in the radius (explode() in actions.ts), 25% ignite chance, 240% effectiveness.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: The area spell also lands beside the target on both sides, widening the covered ground; no extra damage to a single target.
audit.bob: repeats +2 on the same target spot at less damage and a smaller area. The echoes land at the same place a moment later, so it is a three-times repeat (like Spell Echo) rather than a spatial spread; lateral coverage is gone and single-target damage rises.
audit.repair: Replace repeats with two extra instances of the area offset to either side of the target.

audit.poe: Consumes a corpse to give your minions attack, cast and movement speed, with more corpses extending it.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff on the character: 20-30% attack/cast speed and 20-29% move speed for 8 s; the corpse is unused and minions do not receive it.
audit.repair: Apply the speed buff to minions and add corpse-based extension. Unsure whether the real effect also covers the player.

audit.poe: Channelled dagger/claw/sword flurry that stacks up damage while you hold it, then releases extra hits per stage when you stop; the build-up and release is the loop.
audit.bob: A plain melee area arc (120 degrees, radius 1.8) at an averaged 90-126% per hit, with the channelling tag inert in the engine. Both the stack-up and the release hits are gone, so what is left is a wide fast arc without the ramp-and-release trade; no weapon restriction either.
audit.repair: Give an area melee skill a stage counter that grows damage per consecutive use and pays out extra hits on a reset (stand-in for channel then release).

audit.poe: More spell damage in exchange for losing critical strikes.
audit.bob: More spell damage and -100% inc crit chance, which the crit multiplier turns into zero crit chance unless other increases stack.

audit.poe: More poison damage, and hits deal more per poison stack on the target, up to a cap.
audit.bob: More poison damage plus a flat 12% under targetPoisoned; no per-stack scaling, contrary to the port note.
audit.repair: Make the hit bonus scale with the target's poison count up to a cap.

audit.poe: Longer ailment duration, more ailment damage, stronger shock/chill and non-damaging ailments.
audit.bob: Duration and damage for ignite, bleed, poison only; non-damaging ailment effect and shock/chill duration are not included (the engine has the stats).
audit.repair: Add effect.shock/effect.chill/duration.shock stats.

audit.poe: Minion hits can give you a Puppet Master buff; while you have it minions deal more damage; minions aggro from further away.
audit.bob: Averaged into permanent minion damage and a flat minion speed. The buff's uptime from minion hits is not modelled, but in PoE uptime is high when minions fight, so the net is similar. The aggro radius bonus is irrelevant because minions seek enemies 14 tiles away anyway.

audit.poe: More damage while at full life.
audit.bob: More damage under onFullLife.

audit.poe: 15% freeze, added cold damage that grows with frenzy charges, and charge gain when killing a frozen enemy.
audit.bob: 15% freeze, flat added cold, and a chance to gain Fervour on any kill. The cold does not grow with charges (despite the port note) and the kill need not be of a frozen enemy.
audit.repair: Add cold damage per Fervour charge and restrict the charge to kills of frozen enemies.

audit.poe: Aura (50% reserved) giving 16-25% of physical damage as extra cold plus 14-18% more cold damage; the more-cold multiplier makes it good for non-physical cold builds too.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana and adds gain.physical.cold (read by convertChunks, so it works). No more-cold-damage multiplier.
audit.repair: Add a more cold damage mod (damageTypes cold) to the aura.

audit.poe: Two spears that change into a much faster piercing second form with a huge critical-strike chance and multiplier boost; the crit-based second form is why crit casters use it.
audit.bob: A single piercing cold projectile (pierce 99, one projectile) whose damage falls to 50% with distance (behaviour.falloff 0.5, applied in distanceMult), the opposite of Ice Spear's gain in the second form. No form change, no crit boost, no second spear.
audit.repair: Add a behaviour field for a second form (after N tiles the projectile gains crit chance/multiplier and speed) instead of the falloff, and a second spear.

audit.poe: A bow arrow that converts some physical to cold on the target and all physical to cold in a cone behind it, with strong chill.
audit.bob: Bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.4 at impact with 60% cold conversion and +100-195% chill effect (read). The cone behind the target becomes a circular area at the impact.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: A nova of cold from the caster that does extra cold damage to chilled enemies; it can also be cast on Frostbolts for a combo.
audit.bob: Self-centred burst (radius 3.2) with added cold damage conditional on targetChilled (the condition is real). The Frostbolt combo is absent.
audit.repair: Optional: let this burst originate at the projectiles of Glacier Dart.

audit.poe: A big slam that hits the area three times in expanding stages, each slightly weaker, half converted to cold.
audit.bob: A single slam burst (radius 2.4) at 190-240% with 50% cold conversion and a 10% less-damage malus standing in for the stages. Only one hit lands instead of three, so total damage is lower and the stage radii are absent.
audit.repair: Optional: three pulses with growing radius and decaying damage on a ground/burst behaviour.

audit.poe: A trap that detonates in icy blasts dealing cold area damage to everything caught in it.
audit.bob: A trap that goes off when an enemy steps within range and bursts for 150% effectiveness cold damage in a radius of 2.4.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Aura giving cold resistance and raising maximum cold resistance.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for resist.cold and maxResist.cold, both read by defence.ts.

audit.poe: Hits penetrate cold resistance.
audit.bob: Penetration cold, read by the damage calculation.

audit.poe: Channel up to 10 stages to build one huge, wide fire explosion released when you stop; commitment (standing and charging) for a big boom is the whole identity.
audit.bob: A self-centred fire burst (radius 3.2) every 0.5 s at 110% effectiveness with 15% ignite. There is no charge-up, no growing radius or damage, no release; it is a fast fire nova.
audit.repair: Add a charge-up where consecutive uses on the same position stack stages (radius and damage) and a single big burst fires after N stages or on a lull.

audit.poe: Melee hits grant Rage (with a 0.4 s gain cooldown); rage gives added physical damage per 10 rage to the supported skill and the general rage bonuses; decays out of combat.
audit.bob: rageOn.meleeHit 1 per melee hit feeds the engine's rage count (cap 50, decays after 4 s, +1% attack damage, +0.5% attack speed, +0.2% move speed per point). Loop is recognisable. Lost: the 0.4 s per-gain cooldown (an arc hitting five enemies gives five rage) and the skill-specific added-damage-per-rage.

audit.poe: Arrows stick into the target and explode after a fuse; several stuck arrows are consumed by the first explosion, adding their damage and radius, so you shoot a stack and watch it go off. Ignite bonus per stack.
audit.bob: A bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.8 at once with fire conversion and added fire. The sticking, the fuse timer, the stack consumption and the per-stack bonuses are gone, so it is a fire arrow with an explosion.
audit.repair: Let the arrow attach to its target and explode after a timer, with the first explosion absorbing the other stuck arrows' damage and radius.

audit.poe: Half of physical becomes lightning plus extra.
audit.bob: convertSkill/gain physical to lightning.

audit.poe: A fan of ten physical knives cast in an arc; strong clear that shotguns up close.
audit.bob: Spell projectile fan of 10 over 80 degrees at 120% effectiveness. The shared per-use hit list means a lone target takes one knife, so the point-blank shotgun is absent, but the wide fan itself is intact.
audit.repair: None (engine-wide single-target dedupe).

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) Throws a spectral weapon that spirals outward through about 4 rotations and bounces off walls up to three times (extra projectiles become bounces).
audit.bob: The same returning projectile as Phantom Toss (out and back, hits both legs); no spiral, no wall bounces.
audit.repair: Give the projectile a spiral path and wall bounces in place of the plain return, with extra projectiles adding bounces.

audit.poe: Throws a spectral copy of your shield whose damage scales with the shield's armour and evasion, shattering on impact into shards that fly in all directions; the build-around for shield defences.
audit.bob: Needs a shield, then fires a nine-shard physical fan over 120 degrees with flat added damage by gem level. Nothing reads the shield's defences (the port note says it scales with them; the gem has no such mod), and the shatter is a forward fan, not a burst from the impact point.
audit.repair: Add added physical damage per N of shield armour and evasion (the shield stats are already computed in character.ts) and make the shards fan out from the first impact.

audit.poe: A slow, piercing cold projectile; its slowness also lets Ice Nova be cast on the bolts.
audit.bob: Piercing cold projectile (pierce 99, range 9, 160% effectiveness). The projectile moves at the common projectile speed, so it is not slow, and there is no Ice Nova interaction.
audit.repair: Optional: a per-skill projectile speed value.

audit.poe: Creates a wall of ice that blocks enemy movement and damages and pushes back those under it; used for crowd control and kiting.
audit.bob: A 5-tile line ground zone lasting 3 s, pulsing cold damage with a 15% freeze chance. It damages but does not block or push, so only the freeze chance stands in for control.
audit.repair: Let a ground line act as terrain monsters path around (or are held by), plus an outward push on pulse.

audit.poe: Crits give a power charge; more damage per power charge.
audit.bob: chargeOn.crit.insight with per-charge more damage reading held charges.

audit.poe: Always bleeds the target; the bleed lasts 8 s (skill duration, so duration mods scale it) with a 30-49% more bleed damage bonus; a long-bleed applicator for bows, daggers, claws and swords.
audit.bob: 100% bleed chance and bleed-tagged more damage are real, but there is no duration modifier, so the bleed uses the base 5 s (BLEED_DURATION) - the port note's 'eight seconds' is not implemented. It is always a range-9 projectile, even with a dagger or claw.
audit.repair: Add a duration.bleed increase (about +60%) to the gem and let skill-duration mods feed bleed duration; make the stab a melee hit when a melee weapon is held.

audit.poe: Reduces enemy block, spell block and dodge chances, and applies Overpowered to enemies that blocked; the counter to blocking enemies.
audit.bob: Only a flat accuracy bonus for the skill. Enemy block exists in the engine (blockChance in calc/combat.ts, a monster with blockSpell 40, shield-bearers) but the accuracy mod does not touch it; it is Additional Accuracy under the old name.
audit.repair: Add a profile stat that lowers the target's block chances (and an Overpowered stack when a blocked hit occurs); hook is in blockChance().

audit.poe: A strong strike that gives Fortify; it has a 4 s cooldown which you can bypass by spending an Endurance Charge. Used to keep Fortify up between other attacks.
audit.bob: A melee strike that gives Fortify on melee hit (buffOn.meleeHit.fortify, which the engine reads: 20% less damage taken for 4 s). It has no cooldown, so it is simply a spammable fortifying strike, and no charge is spent; the damage is also far below the original's 222-260%.
audit.repair: Give it an explicit cooldown and let a Grit charge be spent to skip it, with a heavier hit to pay for the cooldown.

audit.poe: A relic that follows you and, when you hit with an attack, casts a nova that damages enemies and regenerates life for you and minions.
audit.bob: A ranged relic minion that shoots enemies while the owner gets 3.5-100 life regen (always on); the on-hit nova trigger and the stronger minion regen are not modelled.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A two-handed mace/staff circular swing with 50% lightning conversion that also calls down holy hammers on up to three struck enemies.
audit.bob: A 360-degree self burst with 50% lightning conversion usable with swords, maces, axes and staves (no two-hand limit); the hammers that land on struck enemies are missing.
audit.repair: After the sweep, add reduced-damage area hits on up to three enemies it struck.

audit.poe: Hits maim enemies: they are slowed and take more physical damage, and the skill deals more physical damage against maimed enemies.
audit.bob: More physical damage plus a global hexOnHit.openWounds. The openWounds hex is physical-vulnerability only (hexes.ts fx), so the slow in the description is not implemented. It also shares the single hex slot with curses and with Dazzle/Rout.
audit.repair: Apply a maim debuff with both a movement/action slow and phys vulnerability, outside the hex limit, scoped to the supported skill.

audit.poe: Minions have more maximum life.
audit.bob: minionLife more is used in minionBody, which sets minion max life; works.

audit.poe: More DoT, shorter ailment duration.
audit.bob: More dot damage, duration.* -15%.

audit.poe: Mine support with less base damage but a damage bonus (double-damage chance) against enemies near mines; reconstructed from stat ids, exact wording unsure.
audit.bob: Adds mine, less damage, and 40% more damage under the targetNearby condition. But deployed shots build their profile with playerConds(w, target), and targetNearby is tested between the target and the player (2 tiles + radius), not between the target and the mine, so for a ranged build the bonus is almost never on and the gem is a plain mine with a damage penalty.
audit.repair: Evaluate target-proximity conditions from the deployable's position in shoot(), or count other mines near the target as the bonus.

audit.poe: Supported skills apply the linked curses on hit (no casting). In 3.9 the gem was the older curse-on-hit; poedb's 3.27 page shows reduced curse effect and duration, which I did not hold against Bob.
audit.bob: hexOnHit: the hex gems in the same item as the primary skill are applied to enemies hit (deriveHexes). Scoped to the primary skill's item only for choosing the hexes, but they are applied by all of the character's hits, and share the one-hex limit.

audit.poe: Channelled orb above you that pelts the ground with cold projectiles; channelling builds stages (more duration/fire rate) that decay when you stop - commit-to-ramp skill.
audit.bob: A plain 'burst' nova around the caster at 45% effectiveness, 0.3 s cast, chill. 'channelling' is only a tag in calc/skill.ts (no ramp state); nothing builds up, no orb, no projectiles.
audit.repair: Add a channel_ramp primitive (stages that rise per use and decay after a gap) that scales hit rate/damage, and use it here.

audit.poe: No PoB data. From memory of 3.9 (low confidence; poedb shows only 3.24 values) : marked enemy takes more projectile damage and is easier to hit, with flask charges on hitting it; later versions add projectile splitting.
audit.bob: huntMark hex: character deals 12..25% more projectile damage and +accuracy to the marked, plus 6..15% damage taken. Core projectile-damage-vs-marked loop works.
audit.repair: None needed; flask charges / projectile split are optional extras.

audit.poe: Thrust an axe or sword to throw a main impaling projectile plus four smaller shards; each enemy can only be hit by one projectile, so extra projectiles add coverage, not damage.
audit.bob: Five-projectile fan with 100% impale chance; the engine gives all projectiles of one use a shared hit list, so each enemy is hit once, matching the 'one projectile per enemy' rule. Impale is a real mechanic here (recordImpale/payImpales).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A mine that detonates in a nova of short-lived cold projectiles; extra projectiles with more mines and an aura raising enemy crit chance near it.
audit.bob: A mine that goes off when enemies are near and fires five icicles in a 100 degree fan at range 7; the nearby-enemy crit aura and mine-sequence projectiles are omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Reserve mana for a large more-armour multiplier.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more armour mod, which defence.ts reads through db.calc.

audit.poe: Guard: absorbs 70% of hit damage up to a pool, then ends; shares a cooldown with other guards; cooldown does not recover while up.
audit.bob: Guard utility (policy guard, life<60%, 3 s, cd 8): hitTaken more -35..-50 (real, defence.ts hitTakenMult). Absorb pool becomes a flat reduction; no shared guard cooldown.
audit.repair: Optionally model the pool (absorb up to N damage) and share guard cooldowns.

audit.poe: A trap that damages one enemy and immobilises it, then slows it and makes it take more damage from your traps and mines; it is a trap/mine setup and control tool.
audit.bob: A trap with a big physical burst (200% effectiveness) and a 30% lower enemy stun threshold; nothing holds or slows the enemy and there is no trap/mine vulnerability, so the port note 'holds it for a few seconds' is false. The enemyStunThreshold stat only affects stun chance (src/calc/combat.ts).
audit.repair: Add an enemy root/slow status (a timed move-speed multiplier) and a debuff giving more damage taken from trap and mine hits.

audit.poe: Channel to build stages, zapping nearby enemies as you do, then release a powerful lightning beam; ramp and release is the loop.
audit.bob: A self-centred burst (radius 3) every 0.25 s at 45% effectiveness, half physical converted to lightning, with the channelling tag inert. The stage build-up and the release beam are both absent, so it is a fast lightning nova.
audit.repair: Add a stage counter that grows with hits and, after a lull or at a cap, fires one large beam at the target (stand-in for release).

audit.poe: Flat accuracy.
audit.bob: Flat accuracy, read by hit chance.

audit.poe: Aura giving flat accuracy and increased critical strike chance.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for base accuracy and inc critChance, both read by the profile code.

audit.poe: Added fire damage against burning (ignited) enemies: rewards stacking ignite from another source.
audit.bob: Gives its own 30% ignite chance and more ignite damage; no added flat fire and no dependence on an already-ignited target. The engine has the targetIgnited condition, but the gem does not use it.
audit.repair: Add flat fire damage under the targetIgnited condition and drop the self-ignite chance.

audit.poe: No PoB data; memory plus poedb (current values, 3.9 similar): warcry that exerts your next attacks (Combust: fire area hit on the first hit of each exerted attack), converts phys to fire scaling with enemy power, and makes enemies explode on death.
audit.bob: Plain timed buff (8 s, cd 8): 25..40% more attack damage and 20% ignite chance. No exert counter, no Combust, no death explosion, no fire conversion.
audit.repair: Add an exert_next_attacks primitive (counter of N attacks that get more damage plus an extra fire area hit) and use it for the warcry family.

audit.poe: Half of cold damage converts to fire, plus some cold gained as fire.
audit.bob: convertSkill and gain handled in convertChunks with ancestry.

audit.poe: A mana-reserving aura that adds fire damage to attacks and spells for you and allies.
audit.bob: A 50% mana reserve aura that adds flat fire damage by level to the character's hits; minions are not covered, but the added-damage aura role is intact.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: More melee damage to close enemies, scaling with distance; usable only with axes or swords; hits give a short speed buff for travel skills (poedb).
audit.bob: Flat more damage to enemies within 2 tiles plus radius; no weapon restriction, no hit buff, no distance gradient. The damage trade works, but it loses its restriction-for-power.
audit.repair: Restrict to axe and sword attacks (needs a support-side weapon filter).

audit.poe: A ballista totem fires long, deeply piercing arrows; you choose it for repeated piercing hits from several bow turrets.
audit.bob: Three ballistas (deployCount 2 extra) each fire a single arrow with pierce 9 at range 11 using your bow; totems shoot on their own while the character fights.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Cast curse that slows enemies' actions and also makes buffs and ailments on them expire more slowly (40% slower, so their debuffs and effects on them last longer), a utility curse for control and DoT builds.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit. The slow is real (speedMult drives action timing and movement in the sim). The slower expiry of effects on enemies (Bob's own ailments and hexes) is absent.
audit.repair: Make it castable and scale tick-down of ailments and hexes on cursed targets by the curse's slow factor.

audit.poe: Cheaper skill; casting builds Inspiration charges that raise elemental damage and crit chance until a mana-spent threshold clears them. Self-generating.
audit.bob: Real 30% cost reduction, but the charge loop is folded into the shared Insight charge and the gem generates none; the per-charge crit and damage bonus only works if another item grants Insight. On its own it is just a cheaper skill.
audit.repair: Give the gem a chargeOn.cast-style source (or its own charge that gains with mana spent and resets on a threshold).

audit.poe: More ailment damage, less hit damage.
audit.bob: More dot-tagged damage and less hit-tagged damage; both applied separately.

audit.poe: Longer-lasting skill effects (zones, minions, trap and curse durations) with only a mana multiplier cost (poedb 3.27: no damage penalty).
audit.bob: skillDuration more plus an invented 15% less damage. Because the sim ignores skillDuration for ground zones, curses and buffs, the benefit works only on deployables and timed minions while the damage penalty always applies; the sheet and the sim disagree for zone skills.
audit.repair: Wire skillDuration into zone pulses and hex/buff duration in the sim; do not add an invented drawback.

audit.poe: Slower projectiles that deal more damage.
audit.bob: projectileSpeed down, damage up.

audit.poe: Added lightning, shock chance, and a buff after killing a shocked enemy.
audit.bob: Added lightning plus 20% shock chance; the buff after killing a shocked enemy is dropped (secondary).

audit.poe: Detonating a mine may grant Power or Frenzy charges; power charges add mine crit chance, frenzy charges speed mine laying.
audit.bob: Same mechanism as Livewire Snares with critChance per Insight charge. Charges roll on each hit by a mine; works through p.gains.

audit.poe: Triggering a trap may grant a Power or Frenzy charge; power charges raise trap crit multiplier, frenzy charges raise throw speed.
audit.bob: chargeOn.hit.insight and chargeOn.hit.fervour are rolled by the skill's gains each time a trap hit lands (the deployed shot keeps isPlayer, so rollCharges runs); each Insight charge adds crit multiplier via per charges.insight. The frenzy charge's throw-speed bonus is replaced by Fervour's generic speed.

audit.poe: A sturdy totem that taunts nearby monsters so they attack it instead of you, soaking hits and giving a zone of safety.
audit.bob: Only a guard buff of 15-25% less damage taken for 8 s when life is low; there is no totem, no taunt and no redirect. Deployables are not actors, enemies cannot target them (src/sim/deploy.ts), so nothing absorbs hits.
audit.repair: Make deployables targetable actors with life and let enemy AI pick a taunting totem within radius before the player.

audit.poe: A fire slam that sends fissures forward; with an Endurance Charge it can spend the charge for a Charged Slam with more damage, bigger area and more fissures.
audit.bob: A burst slam with 50% fire conversion and a 20% ignite chance (the ignite is not in the original); it never consumes charges, so the grit (Endurance analog) interaction is missing.
audit.repair: Let the slam spend one Grit charge for more damage and area (charges and their spending hooks exist in sim/charges.ts).

audit.poe: Aura giving more damage over time and increased skill effect duration; the pick for DoT builds (poison, bleed, ignite, ground DoTs).
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more damage mod on the dot tag (ailment contexts carry dot) and increased poison/ignite/bleed durations. Ground/buff durations (skillDuration stat) are not raised, a small gap.
audit.repair: Optionally add skillDuration inc so ground and buff durations lengthen too.

audit.poe: A short-lived totem with an aura that regenerates life for you and allies standing near it; used as a regeneration window.
audit.bob: A guard-policy buff: cast when life is under 60% and not already up, it gives 6-160 life regen a second for 8 s (cooldown 10 s); it is not a physical totem and minions are not healed, but the regen window matches.
audit.repair: None needed (allies/minions regen is the only nuance).

audit.poe: Every third use of the melee attack is a big hit: much more damage, a longer stun, and extra bleed damage; a rhythm/burst support with a counter.
audit.bob: Averaged into a permanent more melee damage and more bleed damage (value is exactly one third of the PoE big-hit bonus). No counter, no big hit, no stun component.
audit.repair: Count melee uses of the supported skill in the sim and apply the big-hit mods (damage, bleed, stun duration) on every third; keep the sheet on the average.

audit.poe: Culling strike: enemies left below 10% life die.
audit.bob: culling flag read in sim/combat.ts at CULLING_SHARE 0.1; plus some damage.

audit.poe: A wand volley that culls low-life enemies and feeds power charges; crit chance (and multiplier) scales with power charges, so it is the charge-building crit wand skill.
audit.bob: Five-bolt wand fan with culling strike (real), 20% chance on hit to gain an Insight (power-charge analog) charge (real, rollCharges), and +20% crit chance increase per Insight charge (per: charges.insight is read by the engine). Missing the crit-multiplier per charge, and the gain is not limited to rare/unique targets (chargeOn ignores conditions).
audit.repair: Optionally add critMulti per Insight charge.

audit.poe: Fires an arrow to a spot where a clone is summoned that uses your bow for a few seconds.
audit.bob: Summons a bow clone for 3 s that shoots enemies; it appears next to the player instead of at the arrow's landing point.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A ballista totem lobs fire arrows that land in a line and each explode in an area, so it is an AoE ground-pounder from a bow totem.
audit.bob: Up to three ballistas fire a 6-arrow fan of plain fire-converted projectiles (no explodeRadius, no area tag) that hit only what they touch; the ground-impact explosion that defines it is gone.
audit.repair: Give the behaviour explodeRadius (the projectile engine already supports it) and the area tag so arrows burst where they land or hit.

audit.poe: A mine that blasts an area and then rains fiery projectiles around it, while an aura makes nearby enemies take added fire damage.
audit.bob: A mine with a single fire burst (radius 2.4, 80%); the follow-up projectile rain and the fire-damage-taken aura are absent.
audit.repair: Add a secondary ring of small explosions or projectiles after the first burst and a fire-damage-taken debuff on enemies near the mine.

audit.poe: Cast curse: enemies take increased physical damage and increased physical damage over time, and your attacks against them can bleed and maim.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit; physical vulnerability is real (hexVuln in rawHit and hits). No physical DoT vulnerability, no bleed-and-maim on attack, and the engine has no maim at all.
audit.repair: Make it castable, add a physical DoT taken mod, and a self mod giving bleed chance against cursed targets (maim needs a new slow primitive).

audit.poe: Each cast adds a blade (max 10) to a persistent orbit around you that hits everything nearby every 0.6 s, with hit rate, crit and damage rising per blade; the loop is stacking blades, then fighting from the middle of them.
audit.bob: A self-centred nova (radius 2.4) fired every cast (0.6 s). No persistent blades, no stacking per cast, no per-blade scaling; the hit rate does match a full orbit roughly.
audit.repair: Make the cast add a stack to a timed self-centred zone that pulses on its own, with per-stack hit rate, crit and damage.

audit.poe: Minions deal more damage.
audit.bob: minionDamage more; summonMinions stores prof.minionDamage on each minion and attack damage multiplies by it. Works.

audit.poe: Minions move, attack and cast faster.
audit.bob: minionSpeed inc multiplies the minion's movement speed and its attack rate (m.speed in tickMinions). Works.

audit.poe: More spell and DoT damage, longer skill duration.
audit.bob: More spell damage and more DoT; duration is not included.

audit.poe: Curse that makes the cursed enemy grant the attacker a melee buff when hit by melee: more melee damage and increased attack speed. A melee-only curse.
audit.bob: hardTimes hex: target takes 10..19% increased damage of every type (vulnAll). No attack speed, not melee-restricted (spell and bow builds benefit equally), no buff-on-hit step.
audit.repair: Make it a mark-style hex with selfMods (more melee damage and attack speed against the target) instead of vulnAll.

audit.poe: Throws a spectral copy of your weapon that flies out and returns, hitting enemies along its path both ways.
audit.bob: A returning projectile (behaviour returns:true: it reverses at max range, resets its hit list and hits again on the way back, verified in updateProjectiles).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Projectiles pierce a number of enemies, with some more damage at high level.
audit.bob: The pierce stat is read (pierceLeft in updateProjectiles); projectiles pass through and continue.

audit.poe: Mark: enemy is less evasive; hits on it return life and mana, kills fill flask charges and may give a frenzy charge.
audit.bob: flaskMark hex: 6..15% increased damage taken, and the character gets chargeOn.kill.fervour 20..35 vs the marked. Evasion reduction, life/mana on hit and flask charges dropped.
audit.repair: Add recover.hit life/mana and flask-charge-on-kill selfMods to the hex.

audit.poe: Increased critical strike chance (plus a small base crit).
audit.bob: Increased crit chance plus some crit multiplier (a Bob extra); numbers differ only.

audit.poe: Each attack randomly picks fire, cold or lightning (never twice in a row) and deals only that element, with an area burst that is larger if the target has the matching ailment, and extra damage per elemental ailment on the target.
audit.bob: A melee strike with no physical or chaos damage, and added fire and cold damage together every hit (no lightning), plus 10-16% ignite/freeze/shock chances. Nothing picks an element, no area burst, no ailment-count damage bonus.
audit.repair: Pick one of three elements per use (not repeating) that sets the added damage and the ailment, add a small area burst on hit and a more-damage per distinct elemental ailment on the target.

audit.poe: Melee strike converting all physical to a random element per use; depending on the element it also releases a fire explosion, an arcing lightning bolt, or an icy wave.
audit.bob: Melee single-target hit with 'noPhysicalDamage' (calc/skill.ts filters out phys chunks, so the weapon's damage is discarded) and flat added fire damage, plus 15% each ignite/freeze/shock chance. No random element, no conversion of weapon damage, and the 'projectile' tag adds nothing: no explosion, arc or wave is fired (behaviour is plain melee).
audit.repair: Roll an element per use (hit-level conversion of 100% phys to it) and fire a follow-up area / chain / cone for that element from the target.

audit.poe: Consumes a targeted corpse: it explodes for a share of the corpse's life, then becomes a geyser that fires projectiles around it for 8 s. Needs a corpse, so it is a use-what-you-killed skill.
audit.bob: A ground zone at the target (radius 2.5, 2.4 s, pulses every 0.8 s) with fire hits. No corpse needed or consumed (the engine has no corpses), no corpse-life explosion, shorter duration.
audit.repair: Add a corpse record on enemy death and let the skill consume the nearest one, scaling an opening explosion by its life, then leave the existing ground zone for the geyser.

audit.poe: Totem that fires streams of flame at nearby enemies and leaves consecrated ground.
audit.bob: Totem type: deploy.ts places a totem that shoots 3 projectiles half-converted to fire at enemies in reach, for the totem duration. Consecrated ground and channel are dropped.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A slam in front that sends out a wave, with extra stun chance and more damage on enemies close to you.
audit.bob: Slam burst (radius 2.6) with a 25% enemy stun threshold reduction (read) and 40-49% more damage to nearby targets (targetNearby condition, within 2 tiles of the caster). Centred on the target rather than a wave in front.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Totem that releases shockwaves, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies.
audit.bob: Totem that fires a self-centred burst r3 of physical spell damage on its own. No knockback, which is minor.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Pure increased cast speed.
audit.bob: Increased cast speed, read by the engine.

audit.poe: No-damage blink with a 2 s cooldown toward a location; pure mobility.
audit.bob: Utility blink (distance 7, cd 2): when the target is out of reach, the player jumps toward it (utility.ts). Gap-closer only; no free aiming, which is the legitimate autobattler adaptation.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: 25% reserved aura giving increased attack speed, cast speed and movement speed.
audit.bob: Reserves 25% mana and applies attackSpeed, castSpeed and moveSpeed inc mods, all read by the engine.

audit.poe: A fast bow/wand attack that gives a Frenzy charge on hit; each charge makes the skill itself faster and stronger. Build then spend by firing.
audit.bob: Bow/wand attack with chargeOn.hit.fervour 100 (read through the skill's gain mods) and 5% more damage and 5% more attack speed per Fervour charge held (per-stat scaling uses the character's held charges). Charges are Bob's Fervour kind, 10 s, max 3.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Barrage (the active gem) makes a short preparation, then fires its projectiles one after another (40% of base damage each, small random spread of about 20 degrees); because they are sequential, they can all strike the same target, which is the skill (big single-target damage up close). (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: A tight fan of 5 arrows fired together at 60-72% each. A use hits each target once, so it plays as a second Split Volley.
audit.repair: Fire the volleys in sequence, each with its own hit list, at the gem's per-volley damage.

audit.poe: Five volleys of blades fall on an area, each wider and weaker than the last, with a big crit-chance bonus.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target (radius 2.5, 1.5 s, pulses every 0.3 s = 5 volleys) with +100% crit chance. The per-volley widening and damage fall-off are not modelled, so all five hit the same circle at equal strength.
audit.repair: Optional: per-pulse radius growth and damage decay on ground behaviours.

audit.poe: Raises zombies from corpses, up to 3-7, tanky melee minions with an unevadable slam.
audit.bob: Summons 3-7 zombies with large life, melee reach and splash, followed by a respawn when recast; no corpse is needed (accepted engine divergence).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Warcry: increased damage scaling with nearby enemies plus mana regeneration for you and allies, taunting.
audit.bob: Utility buff (rally, cd 4, 8 s): inc damage 24..40 and manaRegenFlat 1.8..14.8, real buff mods behind a condition. Per-enemy scaling averaged; allies/taunt irrelevant.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate for a big buff (more damage, attack and move speed, less damage taken); needs minimum rage; length depends on stored rage.
audit.bob: Rally buff (8 s, cd 12): more attack damage 15..20, more attack speed, move speed, less hit taken. Bob has rage (rageOn.*, w.rage), but Berserk neither requires nor consumes it - a cooldown buff with free uptime.
audit.repair: Require min rage to cast, drain rage while active at an accelerating rate, and end the buff when rage runs out.

audit.poe: A wide melee arc that hits every enemy in front and strikes with both weapons when dual wielding (with a dual-wield damage penalty); axes and swords only.
audit.bob: Arc melee (120 degrees, radius 2.2) that hits every enemy in the cone; with two weapons it hits with both hands (the arc branch in fire() loops over all hands, so this one really works). No axe/sword restriction and no dual-wield damage penalty.
audit.repair: Optional: add requiresWeapon axe/sword and a final damage malus while dual wielding; no engine change needed.

audit.poe: Linked spells are cast when you are stunned; a reactive trigger that turns being hit into spells.
audit.bob: Trigger on hitTaken: fires after 20% of max life has been taken since the last firing, 0.5 s cooldown, castSocketed for the linked spells (made triggered so they are never the primary). Uses damage taken as a stand-in for stun; the reaction to being hurt is intact.

audit.poe: Raises the quality of the supported gem, amplifying its quality bonus; a tuning/utility support rather than a damage gem.
audit.bob: A small inc damage. There is no quality system (DESIGN 2.1: gem quality not modelled), so the gem has no real object; it is a stat gem with the old name.
audit.repair: Reinterpret as a small levelBonus on the supported skill (the Empower hook), or introduce quality.

audit.poe: Attacks gain 25% bleed chance, added physical damage and more bleed damage.
audit.bob: 25% bleed chance and more bleed damage (bleed tag reaches the ailment calc). No added flat physical.

audit.poe: More melee physical damage against bleeding enemies, but the skill cannot cause bleeding: needs another bleed source.
audit.bob: Same: chance.bleed -1000 removes the skill's bleeding; more damage under the targetBleeding condition, evaluated live in the sim.

audit.poe: Projectiles (and chain skills) chain to further enemies after hitting, at a damage penalty; how projectiles clear packs.
audit.bob: Adds chains +2 and a damage penalty, but only skills with chain behaviour read 'chains' (sim actions.ts chain branch). On a normal projectile skill (bow, bolt) the chains stat does nothing, so the support is a pure damage penalty. Works only on the ~5 chain-native skills.
audit.repair: Let projectile skills chain on hit: redirect the projectile to the nearest unhit enemy up to the chain count.

audit.poe: A golem that gives you increased critical strike chance and accuracy.
audit.bob: One cold golem; the owner gets 20-30% increased crit chance and accuracy (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Place a crystal that pulses a debuff (cold exposure, slowed regen) and then explodes for heavy cold damage when its duration ends; you pick it as a set-and-detonate exposure applier.
audit.bob: A 2 s ground zone pulsing full spell hits every 0.5 s with 25% cold penetration standing in for exposure (penetration is read by the engine); there is no end-of-life explosion and no regen debuff.
audit.repair: Let a ground zone carry an 'on expiry' burst (a heavier hit at the zone's end) and make the pulses debuff-only or weak.

audit.poe: Area curse: -cold resistance and extra chance for the target to be frozen by cold.
audit.bob: coldSap hex: -25..-44% cold resistance in r3.5, working. Freeze-chance-taken half absent.
audit.repair: Optionally add enemy-side 'extra freeze chance' to the hex.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A cold projectile bursts at impact or the target point and leaves a chilling area that deals cold damage over time and creeps toward nearby enemies for about 5 s.
audit.bob: A 3 s cold ground zone at the target pulsing every 0.5 s, with increased chill effect (real: effect.chill is consumed, cold hits can chill). It is stationary and has no projectile or creeping, but the lasting chilling-field loop is there.
audit.repair: Optionally let a ground zone drift toward the nearest enemy.

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: added cold damage to attacks and spells, and shattering (killing) a frozen enemy makes it explode in AoE cold damage.
audit.bob: Added cold base damage works. A kill trigger on a frozen enemy (targetHas freeze) explodes for 8% of its max life as cold in radius 2.5, drained through the explosion queue so chains work. Damage is life-based rather than flat, which is a number change.

audit.poe: A heavy cold-converted mace/staff hit with a freeze chance; frozen enemies on low life shatter, the third strike in a row freezes more easily, and it adds cold damage to chilled enemies. The freeze to shatter combo is the niche.
audit.bob: Heavy melee at 155-200% with 60% cold conversion, 25% freeze chance and increased chill effect (all read). The shatter, the third-hit combo and the damage vs chilled enemies are gone (the port note admits the shatter is dropped).
audit.repair: Add an execute on frozen enemies below a third of life (the engine has a culling check that could take a frozen condition) and a consecutive-hit counter for extra freeze.

audit.poe: Reserved buff that cuts physical and fire hit damage only while stationary, chills (30% slow) any attacker that hits you, and lays chilled ground when you move. A stand-and-tank defence that punishes melee attackers.
audit.bob: Reserves 25% mana for a flat all-type hitTaken reduction at all times. The engine has a stationary condition (sim combat.ts) and nothing to chill attackers on being hit; neither is used.
audit.repair: Gate the reduction on the stationary condition for physical and fire only, and add a hit-taken trigger that chills the attacker.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A shield retaliation: usable for 2 s after a block, sweeps a cone of ice, 100% cold, and always freezes, with off-hand damage scaled by the shield's defences; 3.5 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use shield swipe with only 50% cold conversion and a 20% freeze chance; the block-gated retaliation, guaranteed freeze and shield scaling are all gone.
audit.repair: Gate on a post-block window with a 3.5 s cooldown, convert 100% to cold with guaranteed freeze, and scale damage with shield defences.

audit.poe: Added cold damage to hits.
audit.bob: As Venom Seed, cold.

audit.poe: A series of icicle bursts erupting in a rolling line out from the caster, each damaging enemies in it, half converted to cold.
audit.bob: Ground zone as a strip (line 6, radius 1.6) pulsing 5 times at 0.2 s with 60% cold conversion. All five pulses hit the whole strip at once rather than travelling outward.
audit.repair: Optional: sequence the pulses along the line.
